Why Hutaib

A systems partner you can hold to the plan.

Projects fail on the details: a camera that cannot see the gate, a door that will not fail safe, a network that was never sized for the load. We plan for those details before a single item is ordered.

Survey first, not sales first

We visit the site and review existing systems, coverage, entry points and constraints before recommending equipment.

Designed and documented

A clear solution design, equipment schedule and scope of work, so you know exactly what is being approved and why.

Installed by one team

Cabling, cameras, access rules and integrations are delivered and tested by the same team — not handed between vendors.

Supported after go-live

Training, as-built documentation, warranty support and optional maintenance keep your systems dependable long after handover.

How we work

Six clear steps, from first call to aftercare.

No vague quotes or surprise variations. Each stage has an owner, an output and your sign-off before we move forward.

  1. 01

    Discuss your needs

    A short conversation about your sites, systems, priorities and timeline — with no obligation.

    30 min call · OutputA short requirement brief and clear next step
  2. 02

    Site survey

    We inspect coverage, entry points, existing cabling, power and access constraints.

    1–2 hrs · OutputCoverage, entry points and constraints documented
  3. 03

    Recommend a solution

    Receive a right-sized design, equipment list, clear scope and a proposed delivery programme.

    2–3 days · OutputRight-sized design, equipment list and written scope
  4. 04

    Installation & configuration

    Our team installs to the agreed plan, coordinating around your operations and building rules.

    By schedule · OutputInstalled to the approved plan with minimal disruption
  5. 05

    Testing & handover

    Commissioning, user training and as-built documentation — before we call the job complete.

    1–2 days · OutputCommissioning records, training and documentation
  6. 06

    Ongoing support

    Warranty support, preventive maintenance and advice as your sites, teams and systems grow.

    Ongoing · OutputPreventive checks and responsive on-site support

FAQs

Good questions, answered clearly.

A few things clients ask before a site survey. If your question is not here, call or message the team — we will give you a straight answer.

Our team is based in Dubai and delivers projects across the UAE, including Sharjah, Abu Dhabi, Ajman and Ras Al Khaimah. We also support projects in Saudi Arabia and Oman.

Yes. We start with a site survey to check coverage, entry points, existing cabling and any constraints. You then receive a recommended design, equipment list and clear scope before work begins.

Yes. We audit the existing CCTV, access control, networking and IT setup, keep what is working, and recommend a phased upgrade where a full replacement is not necessary.

We design with established technology partners including Avigilon and Mobotix for surveillance, FingerTec for time attendance, and Evoko and Wisemeet for meeting-room booking. The right fit depends on your site and budget.

We test the system, train your team, hand over as-built documentation and provide warranty support. Optional annual maintenance contracts cover preventive checks, remote help and on-site support.

It depends on scope, site readiness and equipment lead times. After the survey we confirm a delivery programme in writing and keep you updated on milestones through to handover.

Yes. We design CCTV, access control, visitor management, Wi-Fi, structured cabling and meeting-room systems as one coordinated environment, rather than separate disconnected installations.
